+# Taskboard CLI
+
+A dependency-free TypeScript task manager for Bun. Tasks are stored in
+`.taskboard.json` in the current directory, or at `TASKBOARD_FILE` when set.
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts add --title "Ship release" --tags work,urgent --due 2026-09-10
+bun run src/cli.ts list --status open --tag work
+bun run src/cli.ts list --overdue 2026-09-11
+bun run src/cli.ts done 1
+bun run src/cli.ts delete 1
+bun run src/cli.ts stats
+```
+
+Each invocation writes exactly one JSON value to stdout. Errors are also
+reported to stderr and return a non-zero exit status.

1: import { readFile, rename, unlink, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
2: import { dirname, basename, join } from "node:path";
3: 
4: type Status = "open" | "done";
5: 
6: interface Task {
7:   id: number;
8:   title: string;
9:   status: Status;
10:   createdAt: string;
11:   tags: string[];
12:   due?: string;
13:   completedAt?: string;
14: }

16: interface Database {
17:   tasks: Task[];
18:   nextId: number;
19: }
20: 
21: const databasePath = process.env.TASKBOARD_FILE || ".taskboard.json";
22: 
23: function fail(message: string): never {
24:   throw new Error(message);
25: }
26: 
27: function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
28:   return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
29: }
30: 
31: function isValidDate(value: string): boolean {
32:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return false;
33:   const [year, month, day] = value.split("-").map(Number);
34:   const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
35:   return (
36:     date.getUTCFullYear() === year &&
37:     date.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 &&
38:     date.getUTCDate() === day
39:   );
40: }
41: 
42: function validateTask(value: unknown): value is Task {
43:   if (!isRecord(value)) return false;
44:   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value.id) || (value.id as number) < 1) return false;
45:   if (typeof value.title !== "string" || value.title.trim() === "") return false;
46:   if (value.status !== "open" && value.status !== "done") return false;
47:   if (typeof value.createdAt !== "string" || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(value.createdAt))) return false;
48:   if (!Array.isArray(value.tags) || !value.tags.every((tag) => typeof tag === "string")) return false;
49:   if (value.due !== undefined && (typeof value.due !== "string" || !isValidDate(value.due))) return false;
50:   if (
51:     value.completedAt !== undefined &&
52:     (typeof value.completedAt !== "string" || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(value.completedAt)))
53:   ) return false;
54:   if (value.status === "done" && typeof value.completedAt !== "string") return false;
55:   if (value.status === "open" && value.completedAt !== undefined) return false;
56:   return true;
57: }
58: 
59: function validateDatabase(value: unknown): Database {
60:   if (!isRecord(value) || !Array.isArray(value.tasks) || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.nextId)) {
61:     return fail("Malformed taskboard database");
62:   }
63:   if ((value.nextId as number) < 1 || !value.tasks.every(validateTask)) {
64:     return fail("Malformed taskboard database");
65:   }
66: 
67:   const tasks = value.tasks as Task[];
68:   const ids = new Set(tasks.map((task) => task.id));
69:   const maxId = tasks.reduce((maximum, task) => Math.max(maximum, task.id), 0);
70:   if (ids.size !== tasks.length || (value.nextId as number) <= maxId) {
71:     return fail("Malformed taskboard database");
72:   }
73:   return { tasks, nextId: value.nextId as number };
74: }

76: async function loadDatabase(): Promise<Database> {
77:   try {
78:     const contents = await readFile(databasePath, "utf8");
79:     return validateDatabase(JSON.parse(contents));
80:   } catch (error) {
81:     if (isRecord(error) && error.code === "ENOENT") return { tasks: [], nextId: 1 };
82:     if (error instanceof SyntaxError) return fail("Malformed taskboard database");
83:     throw error;
84:   }
85: }

87: async function saveDatabase(database: Database): Promise<void> {
88:   const temporaryPath = join(
89:     dirname(databasePath),
90:     `.${basename(databasePath)}.${process.pid}.${Date.now()}.tmp`,
91:   );
92:   try {
93:     await writeFile(temporaryPath, `${JSON.stringify(database, null, 2)}\n`, { flag: "wx" });

98:     } catch {
99:       // Preserve the original write or rename error.

102:   }
103: }

105: function parseOptions(
106:   args: string[],
107:   allowed: ReadonlySet<string>,
108: ): Map<string, string> {
109:   const options = new Map<string, string>();
110:   for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index += 2) {
111:     const flag = args[index];
112:     if (!flag?.startsWith("--") || !allowed.has(flag)) fail(`Unknown flag: ${flag ?? ""}`);
113:     if (options.has(flag)) fail(`Duplicate flag: ${flag}`);
114:     const value = args[index + 1];
115:     if (value === undefined || value.startsWith("--")) fail(`Missing value for ${flag}`);
116:     options.set(flag, value);
117:   }
118:   return options;
119: }

121: function parseId(value: string | undefined): number {
122:   if (value === undefined || !/^[1-9]\d*$/.test(value)) fail("ID must be a positive integer");
123:   const id = Number(value);
124:   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(id)) fail("ID must be a positive integer");
125:   return id;
126: }

128: function localDate(): string {
129:   const now = new Date();
130:   const year = now.getFullYear();
131:   const month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
132:   const day = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
133:   return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
134: }
135: 
136: async function run(args: string[]): Promise<unknown> {
137:   const [command, ...rest] = args;
138:   if (!command) fail("Missing command");
139: 
140:   if (command === "add") {
141:     const options = parseOptions(rest, new Set(["--title", "--tags", "--due"]));
142:     const title = options.get("--title")?.trim();
143:     if (!title) fail("--title is required and must not be empty");
144:     const due = options.get("--due");
145:     if (due !== undefined && !isValidDate(due)) fail("Invalid due date");
146:     const tags = [...new Set(
147:       (options.get("--tags") ?? "")
148:         .split(",")
149:         .map((tag) => tag.trim().toLowerCase())
150:         .filter(Boolean),
151:     )];
152:     const database = await loadDatabase();
153:     const task: Task = {
154:       id: database.nextId,
155:       title,
156:       status: "open",
157:       createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
158:       tags,
159:       ...(due === undefined ? {} : { due }),
160:     };
161:     database.tasks.push(task);
162:     database.nextId += 1;
163:     await saveDatabase(database);
164:     return task;
165:   }
166: 
167:   if (command === "list") {

169:     const status = options.get("--status");

177:     const database = await loadDatabase();
178:     return database.tasks

183:       ))

192:     if (!task) fail(`Task ${id} not found`);
193:     if (task.status === "open") {
194:       task.status = "done";
195:       task.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
196:       await saveDatabase(database);
197:     }
198:     return task;
199:   }
200: 
201:   if (command === "delete") {
202:     if (rest.length !== 1) fail("Usage: delete ID");
203:     const id = parseId(rest[0]);
204:     const database = await loadDatabase();
205:     const index = database.tasks.findIndex((task) => task.id === id);
206:     if (index === -1) fail(`Task ${id} not found`);
207:     const [task] = database.tasks.splice(index, 1);
208:     await saveDatabase(database);

210:   }

214:     const database = await loadDatabase();

218:       total: database.tasks.length,
